column7: [FEATURE] Official Claude Desktop build for Linux (Ubuntu LTS / Debian)
[FEATURE] Passkey (WebAuthn) sign-in for Claude accounts, across every surface
Mods - make Claude 10x more extensible
[FEATURE] Desktop app: option to make Enter insert a newline and Ctrl+Enter submit in the chat composer
[FEATURE] Session URL appended to commit messages and PR descriptions by default — should be opt-in
Feature request: a supported way to disable the agent_summary spinner (22.7% of requests, ~18% of weighted tokens in a subagent-heavy session)
[FEATURE] Bring back the usage stats panel on the Desktop new session screen
Desktop app: support custom themes / accent colors (parity with CLI custom theme system)
[Feature Request] Add scroll-only mouse mode to disable clicks while preserving wheel scrolling
[Feature Request] Add option to disable clickable Yes/No prompts in terminal
[Feature] Register Claude Code as VSCode Language Model provider to enable Agents window integration
[FEATURE] Create a 'fableplan' alias akin to opusplan
[FEATURE] Desktop app (Code tab): end-of-turn "next-step" box with 1-2 answer buttons gets in the way of real discussion
[Feature Request] Add granular mouse control options to disable click-selection while preserving scroll
[FEATURE] Give users control over weekly limit reset timing (configurable reset day, or banked on-demand resets like Codex)
[FEATURE] Syntax highlighting in VS Code extension chat panel (re-opening closed requests)
[FEATURE] Setting to disable automatic editor group locking in the VS Code extension
Desktop app: option to make Enter insert a newline and submit only via click / Ctrl+Enter
Allow reordering/pinning of session groups in the sidebar
Feature request: org-level default sharing for published artifacts
Desktop app: bring back the context-usage indicator (or make the footer widget configurable)
Hard block on typing passwords breaks legitimate dev/test workflows - needs a permission-gated opt-in for own dev environments
[FEATURE]  VSCode extension: add a "Background Tasks" panel (parity with Desktop app)
Show usage limits on main screen / persistent usage indicator in desktop app
[FEATURE] Add --worktree support for parallel sessions in VS Code (same as Agent View in VSCode does)
statusline: expose per-model weekly rate limits (Opus/Sonnet/Fable) to the status line command
CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE_CLICKS also disables mouse drag-select, not just click-to-approve
[FEATURE] Bring back the usage overview card removed from the desktop app's new-session screen
[FEATURE] Make voice dictation timeouts configurable (15s silence auto-stop, 2min max recording)
[Feature Request] Make AskUserQuestion timeout configurable
Keyboard navigation between user messages in chat conversation (jump to previous/next prompt)
Session list: no way to delete/close a session, only "Archive" (X icon removed)
[FEATURE] Allow configuring a separate model for auto mode classifier via environment variable
[FEATURE] claude.ai: let users set a default permission mode, incl. "Skip all approvals"
[FEATURE] Desktop: assign folders to custom sidebar groups so new sessions are filed automatically
Desktop app: No way to remove entries from the "Recent" folders list
[FEATURE] /workflows support in VSCode extension
[FEATURE] Approve VS Code's Agents window to use an existing claude.ai login (claude login / macOS Keychain)
[FEATURE] Add per-call effort parameter to the Agent (Task) tool
[Feature Request] Make AskUserQuestion timeout configurable
Granular control over mouse click behavior in interactive menus (AskUserQuestion, select prompts)
Claude Desktop (Linux beta): support Fedora/RHEL and atomic/immutable distros (e.g. Bazzite, Silverblue, Kinoite)
[FEATURE] Desktop composer reserves a full-height right gutter, costing ~4 characters per wrapped line
[Feature Request] Auto-cleanup empty .claude/.cc-writes/ directories after execution
[FEATURE] Customizable keyboard shortcuts in Claude desktop app (IDE-style keybindings)
[FEATURE] Feature request: expose a "rename session" tool to the agent (ccd_session_mgmt)
[FEATURE] Desktop app: make the conversation panel wider / support full-width layout
Connect claude.ai Projects to Claude Code (VS Code / CLI)
Feature request: auto-compact on idle timeout to prevent cache expiry cost
[FEATURE] Let me mark an agent session as completed / dismiss it from the agents view
